description: This source file defines the AnalyticsViewModel class for the Android app, which manages and provides analytics data related to trades, including summaries, trade lists, and performance metrics. It interacts with the TradeRepository and performs data loading asynchronously.

classes.name: AnalyticsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class for the Analytics screen that loads and exposes analytics data such as summaries, trades, and performance metrics.

methods.name: loadAnalytics
methods.description: Asynchronously loads analytics data including summary, all trades, and symbol performance, updating LiveData objects accordingly.
